pending.title: REST vs gRPC
outline: Part 1: Diagramming HTTP/1.1 JSON payload overhead versus HTTP/2 Protobuf binary serialization for microservices. But how do you handle real-time streaming in gRPC? Find out in Part 2!
Part 2: Visualizing HTTP/2 multiplexing, client-side streaming, and bidirectional streaming with gRPC code structures.
